adb_status.result: No physical Android device connected via ADB

manual_verification_steps: 1. Connect Android phone or tablet to the same local Wi-Fi (192.168.0.x).
2. Open Google Chrome on Android and navigate to https://192.168.0.14:8443.
3. Proceed past self-signed certificate warning (or install openhands-lan.crt as CA certificate in Android Settings).
4. Tap the three-dot menu in Chrome and tap 'Install app' / 'Add to Home screen'.
5. Open the installed OpenHands app from the home screen: confirm standalone display without browser URL bar.
6. Send a test message or tap the voice microphone icon to verify voice recognition.
